hints.title: Single-Source Distances
hints.text: Compute the shortest paths from the source node to all other reachable nodes in the weighted graph.

hints.title: Greedy Distance Expansion
hints.text: Relax adjacent edges in order of known cumulative distance from the source.

hints.title: Marked Set Query
hints.text: Take the minimum calculated distance across all targets present in the marked list.

hints.title: Shortest Path Implementation

complexity.notes: Standard single-source shortest path using priority expansion.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining paths through DFS visits exponentially many permutations on dense graphs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distance array and adjacency representation scale linearly with graph size.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models non-negative edge weights via Dijkstra algorithm accurately.
